label: Seoul foreign-child childcare support — share of the fee ceiling, ages 3 to 5
unit: % of the applicable childcare fee ceiling
appliesTo: Foreign children aged 3 to 5 at a daycare centre in Seoul. Ages 0 to 2 and qualifying disabled-child childcare are supported at 50%. Foreign registration is required; undocumented residents are not covered.
why: Seoul pays a share of a ceiling rather than a flat amount, so the money changes with the type of centre — which is why Seoul's published figures for private and home daycare sit above the national ages 3–5 rate and cannot be compared with it directly.

history.source: Seoul Metropolitan Government — 2026 foreign-child childcare fee support
history.note: Paid via 국민행복카드. Ages 0–2 and qualifying disabled-child childcare at 50%.
